label: stormcapra faint side
brief: One creature on a neutral stage beside a 1.80 m human ruler: standing, then the faint at three moments (falling, nearly down, down). Judge the creature's model and material as the game's real look - identity, silhouette, appeal, surface and colour, proportion and scale against the ruler - and whether the faint reads as a creature collapsed on the ground.
defects: In the faint the horns stretch into a tube loop over the body and the head is lost
